observations: The default viewport is comic-only and exposes the repaired first-page upper and lower areas without seams or permanent chrome.

The odd-page seek commit shows the repaired second page with continuous geometry and matching upper gray tones; seek preview retains the accepted page while displaying its desired page label in the explicit menu.
Panel closure, Escape and table-of-contents selection return to comic-only imagery. Bottom-right RTL, LTR and vertical samples perform ordinary reading navigation.
The library retains its Reading filter and page 2 of 2. Cross-book detail restores the second book, and Reader restart retains the accepted comic image.

The vertical pair retains page 1, offset 1401 and zoom 2 with matching framing. Desktop lifecycle baseline/resume retain page 20 and two image jobs started; double-tap reset ends at its intended page 13 with zoom 1, and cancelled seek remains at page 12.

The owned demo-asset upgrade shows the repaired page and retains the user's refresh interval of 10. Its remote report verifies unchanged progress, bookmarks, preferences, cover assets and seed marker while atomically refreshing the older owned page.
Failed page 8 rolls back to displayed page 7 with an explicit retry destination; retry accepts page 8 and returns to pure imagery.
Missing and slow first images have visible recovery/loading feedback; an image action before a displayed frame opens a readable wait panel, and dismissal restores loading.
Cross-chapter title and actions distinguish failed/retry chapter 2 page 1 from continued-reading chapter 1 page 1. Retry-in-progress is disabled with loading feedback, then accepts chapter 2.
A pending request for page 8 retains page-7 menu projection and page-action destinations. Reviewed failure reasons are translated categories rather than raw source error text.

pending_requirements: Complete the independent native functional delivery gate before overall delivery. No further UI review round is required by the two-clean-round condition unless the product UI changes or a required UI issue is found.
verification_note: This reviewer only reads source, retained local images, JSON sidecars and remote-generated reports. No local application, build, test suite, smoke test or runtime probe is executed. All application verification is performed by the designated remote worker or isolated firmware guest.

fresh_round_proof.assessment: The retained provenance records disjoint fresh data directories and the same immutable binary across both complete rounds.
